sectors.ai: Buy selective mid-cap consumer names with strong earnings momentum (KKES, COCO, TAPG) as domestic demand holds firm despite global softness; avoid laggards lacking volume growth. Position for Q3 earnings beats and festive-season restocking, prioritizing companies with distribution expansion and margin resilience over broad sector beta.

sectors.name: Crypto & Digital Assets
themes: Indonesia's young, mobile-first population increasingly uses crypto as an inflation hedge and remittance tool, structurally boosting retail participation in global liquid tokens like ARB and UNI.

Layer-2 scalability and DeFi yield protocols are the durable narrative—ARB, CRV, and UNI benefit from sustained on-chain activity growth, independent of short-term macro swings.
sectors.ai: Buy selective DeFi and L2 tokens (ARB, CRV, UNI) on momentum, but keep size small and take profits into strength—this is a beta rally, not a regime shift.
